title: The Rain, 2002
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Fifth January. The dock. Silent. The chair is in the rain too.

panels.composition: Gully's dock in January rain. The lawn chair, still there, soaked. WOOD and BARNABY at the shack's eave.

panels.composition: Same. The chair under the eave. The dog in it. Wood beside. Rain.
